rationale: Engineering teams at AI-native startups with active LLM API spend are a real, paying buyer — the $4,200/month burn story confirms budget and willingness to pay for observability tooling. However, the core product (loop-phase token profiler) requires meaningful integration work — SDK instrumentation or proxy insertion — which pushes buildability below the build gate floor of 6, and ongoing delivery likely needs per-customer setup assistance that reduces operational autonomy below the 7 floor. The idea is commercially sound and worth validating with a waitlist or design-partner calls, but the integration complexity must be de-risked before committing to build.
solution_plan: A token-phase profiler micro-service that wraps an existing agentic loop and reports per-turn token consumption with a cost breakdown by loop phase. The factory builds a lightweight proxy/middleware as a set of Claude prompts plus a simple dashboard page (static HTML + Chart.js), a Stripe subscription link, and an intake form for API key + loop config — no operator coding required. Sell by posting in AI/ML Slack communities (Latent Space, AI Tinkerers), relevant HN 'Show HN' threads, and cold outreach to founders of AI-native startups visible on LinkedIn/X — all outreach batches go out only after operator approval. Delivery is automated: the middleware runs on the customer's infra (or as a hosted proxy), reports are generated by Claude on a schedule, and Stripe handles billing; the only recurring human touch is approving outreach batches and reviewing any flagged support tickets. Realistically, the integration step (connecting to a customer's loop) may require a one-time setup call per customer until the factory produces a truly self-serve onboarding flow — that human touch is the main risk to validate first.
notes: build_gate failed: buildability_with_ai=5 (below min 6) and operational_autonomy=6 (below min 7). Both stem from integration complexity. Validate by offering a free 'loop audit' to 5 design partners to test whether self-serve onboarding is achievable.
